item.title: Nvidia board moves to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang over second alleged affair
item.description:
Nvidia board moves to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang over second alleged affair

Nvidia’s board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a second alleged extramarital affair. This development comes days after Huang admitted to a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.

🔍 Overview

Nvidia’s board will meet to decide Huang’s future at the company, with reports indicating the board may not wait for the results of an ongoing investigation by external counsel. The company’s stock fell more than 7% in after-hours trading following the news.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Second alleged affair: With Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, according to The New York Times.
  • Hotel incident: Huang and Powell were allegedly captured together at a San Jose hotel during Nvidia’s GTC conference in March (sources: The Times).
  • Prior affair: Huang previously admitted to an extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, an alleged spy with ties to Megaspeed.
  • Crisis response: Nvidia retained former US attorney Joon H. Kim’s firm for an investigation. Huang separately hired crisis communications firm Heller in 2025.
  • Stock impact: Shares dropped over 7% in after-hours trading Wednesday.

💡 Why It Matters

The potential dismissal of Huang, a high-profile tech leader, raises questions about Nvidia’s leadership stability and corporate governance. The situation has already impacted investor confidence, as evidenced by the stock decline. The board’s urgency suggests concerns about reputational and operational risks.

#Nvidia #Leadership #Scandal

Source: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang

item.title: Exeon Analytics Expands Leadership Team with New C-Suite Roles
item.description:
Exeon Analytics Expands Leadership Team with New C-Suite Roles

Exeon Analytics has appointed Wayne Jennings as Chief Solutions Officer and Johan Roman as Chief Revenue Officer, expanding its management team to support its next growth phase.

👥 New Leadership Roles

  • Wayne Jennings takes on the newly created position of Chief Solutions Officer.
  • Johan Roman becomes Chief Revenue Officer.

📌 Responsibilities

Name Role Responsibilities
Wayne Jennings Chief Solutions Officer Technical customer lifecycle (pre-sales, proof of concept, implementation, long-term technical account management), technical enablement of partners
Johan Roman Chief Revenue Officer Sales, marketing, channel partnerships, expanding partner network, driving growth in EMEA

📅 Background

  • Wayne Jennings joined Exeon Analytics in July 2024 and initially led Support and Engineering.
  • Before Exeon, he was a Senior Manager in Cybersecurity & Privacy at PwC Switzerland, focusing on threat intelligence and incident response.
  • Johan Roman brings over 15 years of experience in commercial growth, go-to-market strategy, strategic partnerships, and marketing in cybersecurity and technology.
  • He spent over 12 years at Kudelski Security, most recently as Senior Director of Global Alliances, Technology Partnerships & Marketing and a member of the Executive Leadership Team.

🎯 Company Priorities

The expanded management team supports three priorities:

  • Scaling Exeon.UEBA, introduced in January 2026, which complements Exeon.NDR with user, entity, and application behavior analysis to address identity-based attacks.
  • Developing a module for detecting and securing AI agents, available in Q4 2026, to cover autonomous agents with their own access rights.
  • Geographic expansion in further EMEA markets through a growing network of distributors, integrators, and managed security service providers.

💬 Leadership Perspective

“Wayne and Johan bring exactly the combination we need for the years ahead: technical depth close to the customer and experience in scaling go-to-market internationally,” says Gregor Erismann, CEO of Exeon Analytics.

🏢 Company Context

  • The appointments coincide with Exeon Analytics’ 10th anniversary as an ETH Zurich spin-off.
  • The company delivers holistic security analytics for organizations facing growing blind spots, encrypted traffic, and regulatory pressure.

#ExeonAnalytics #Cybersecurity #Leadership #UEBA #AIagents #EMEA

Source: Exeon Analytics expands management team for next growth phase

item.title: Phil Schiller Steps Back from App Store and Apple Events Role
item.description:
Phil Schiller Steps Back from App Store and Apple Events Role

Apple Fellow Phil Schiller is officially reducing his operational responsibilities, stepping down from overseeing the App Store and Apple product launches as the company prepares for a leadership transition to incoming CEO John Ternus.

🔍 Overview

  • Schiller is stepping down from overseeing the App Store and Apple product launches
  • He will retain only his Apple Fellow role
  • The move coincides with John Ternus set to take over as Apple CEO
  • The App Store is returning to Eddy Cue, who oversaw it until 2015

⏰ Background and Workload

  • In 2024, The Wall Street Journal reported Schiller was working close to 80 hours a week
  • As Apple Fellow, Schiller continued to oversee the App Store and Apple events, but the role may not have left him with sufficient time for his own endeavors
  • Schiller was present with Steve Jobs and Tim Cook at the start of Apple’s comeback in 1997–1998
  • He has a combined 35 years of service to Apple: 1987–1993 and 1997 to today

🔄 Organizational Changes

Role Person Details
App Store oversight Eddy Cue Previously oversaw it until 2015; will take more influential role under Ternus
Day-to-day App Store operations Carson Oliver Longtime App Store team member
Apple CEO (incoming) John Ternus Will lead as Schiller steps back
  • Cue is Apple’s services chief and will reportedly be taking a more influential role under Ternus’ leadership
  • Carson Oliver, who has long been on the App Store team, will oversee its day-to-day operations

📋 What This Means

  • Schiller is officially stepping back to only his Apple Fellow role
  • The App Store returns to Eddy Cue after nearly a decade under Schiller
  • Leadership restructuring appears timed to coincide with the CEO transition to Ternus

#Apple #PhilSchiller #AppStore #leadership #JohnTernus #EddyCue

Source: Michael Tsai
